media.title: Hôtel Ritz, Place Vendôme, Paris — context photograph, 1900
media.altText: Photograph of the Hôtel Ritz on Place Vendôme in Paris, around 1900, with pedestrians crossing the square.
media.publicCaption: The Hôtel Ritz on Place Vendôme, Paris, photographed around 1900. Kaper and Jurmann are reported to have met Louis B. Mayer at the Ritz in August 1934, leading to their MGM contract.
media.publicCreditLine: Unknown photographer / Wikimedia Commons, File:Hotel Ritz Paris 1900.jpg.
media.rightsNote: Public domain: photograph published in 1900; the Wikimedia Commons file is released as public domain.

places.publicNote: Paris hotel venue for the reported Ritz meeting with Louis B. Mayer that opened the path to the MGM contract.
